items.title: Restore a real public history page for community play
executionLog: Dedicated /stats/ route, refreshed 53-run dated snapshot, live and offline analysis, 17 reviewed visual captures.
items.why: The live /stats/ URL redirects to /board/, public/stats/index.html is absent, and the stats-surface descriptor still names /stats/ as its page. The leaderboard and aggregate totals are useful but answer different player questions.
items.recipe: Add /stats/ to the shared public route registry, remove the redirect, reuse the live aggregate component, show all recoverable history, 24-hour activity, mode composition, coverage dates and definitions, and retain the scoreboard link. Refresh the dated fallback snapshot from the actual production feed and regenerate the route graph.

items.title: Turn the aggregate into honest analysis instead of unlabeled motion
executionLog: Denominators, coverage, mode mix, recent window, last completed run and browser-local trend scope are explicit.
items.why: The committed fallback snapshot is dated August 8 with 12 runs, while the live endpoint reports 52 supported runs on September 29. The existing sparkline stores at most 48 browser-local observations, so it is not a server-wide history series. A poll timestamp is distinct from the last completed run.
items.recipe: Derive an accessible analysis summary from live runs, supported coverage, 24-hour counts and mode mix; label missing fields as unknown, bound any percentages by their denominator, distinguish server updatedAt from checkedAt, and label browser-local trends as local observations. Keep the dated fallback honest when offline.

L1.recipe: Distinguish live poll time from run-update time and label local trends.

L2.recipe: Add source-derived coverage and mode analysis with explicit denominators, a refreshed snapshot and robust offline labels.

L3.recipe: Verify analysis against live, sparse and legacy-only payloads plus visually inspect responsive fallback/live states.

items.title: Bind public stats claims to an actual reachable page
executionLog: Public contract binds route, descriptor, generated HTML and redirect absence; focused regression passed.
items.why: The machine-readable descriptor claims a /stats/ page while the route registry omits it and _redirects sends it to /board/. The public contract did not reject this mismatch.
items.recipe: Extend the public contract with a targeted stats page/descriptor/redirect coherence assertion and a focused regression case, so generation or deployment cannot claim a page that resolves elsewhere.

skipped.reason: No participant outcome supports a balance or progression target change.
The existing sparkline is stored only in each browser; presenting it as production-wide history would fabricate evidence.
Local evidence-ranked coaching exists; hosted inference lacks a cost-neutral need.
Account integration is a separate Obelisk product decision and cannot be substituted with a project-local login.
Twelve modes and six Operation routes already exist; no player evidence identifies missing breadth.
